t: Two things that take real resolve
a: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
p: Wa la-man ṣabara wa ghafara inna dhālika la-min ʿazmi-l-umūr.
m: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
